reviews.title: App keeps crashing
reviews.text:
I hate this app after only one half day.  I’ve been “welcomed” dozens of times now and every time I’m putting in my preferences it crashes turns off and I have to start all over again this is getting old and I’m going to start stress eating. LOL
Worst $50 I’ve ever spent.

reviews.text: I just want to track how long I fast not what I eat or drink or how I exercise. And then you want me to pay for a subscription? F this.

reviews.title: Not worth it
reviews.text: I’d give this zero stars if I could. This app doesn’t deliver anymore than apps you can get for free. There’s no trial period and there are A LOT of useless questions when you’re basically just getting a timer for fasting. When I requested a refund after just a few minutes of realizing it isn’t any better than free apps, it was denied. Save your money and look for something free.

reviews.title: What is this
reviews.text: Asked me a thousand questions before I could use the app. Gave up. Just trying to track my fast, not collaborate on every detail of my health.

reviews.title: Don’t bother downloading
reviews.text: Makes you fill out a super extensive survey only to then put up a paywall asking for 3.99 a week! Unbelievably scummy tactics trying to bait you into subscribing to an app that you haven’t even been able to try/has no free/ad version. Avoid

reviews.title: Too many questions
reviews.text: When an app asked me 30 questions before I even get a chance to set it up I am suddenly see a huge paywall. I don’t even know what this because I deleted it after about the 25th question some of them phrased like a goofy sales pitch. Moving on looking for something else now.

reviews.title: NOT FREE!
reviews.text: Went through tons of questions as they were setting up a personalized plan. After all that, you can’t go any further unless you pay like 3 or 4 bucks a week. Super disappointed. Not cool.

reviews.title: App is problematic
reviews.text: I selected my sex as female because that’s what I was assigned as at birth but after that i kept seeing pictures of women and it kept mentioning women. I am not a women and I  don’t want to see lots of woman. It says made by women for women. Not only that but it doesn’t have a gender option only the sex and it just assumes your gender. This app is problematic and harmful.
